verdict.rationale: Full-text search is a fair axis for a backend-as-a-service database, but the evidence pack never documents a full-text search capability. Generic indexes, vector similarity search over embeddings, and a dedicated PostgreSQL engine are adjacent features, not documented built-in full-text search, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run full-text search over my data without wiring up an external search service
